listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Melee — MeleePad (chrissotraidis)
listing.summary: The project reports native gameplay in Preview 7. Private Slippi online play has separate requirements. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GALE01 v1.00 or v1.02 disc. Slippi online play requires a private v1.02 build and an account.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use PadMint to compile the game locally from your own disc with the published app. The public app does not include game code.

warnings: The project reports native gameplay in Preview 7. Private Slippi online play has separate requirements.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
